Section: section_1 — Prerequisite Recap: The Area of a Parallelogram

Lecture lines:
[Asset: Det_Intro] Determinants measure the area of a parallelogram.
[Asset: Parallelogram_Visual] Vectors v1 and v2 define the space.
[Asset: Formula_Display] Area equals the absolute determinant value.

Planned animations:
Fade in parallelogram with base b and height h.
Label base b in #FFD700 color.
Label height h in #FFD700 color.
Show Area = b * h formula in #FFFFFF color.
Highlight Area result with flash effect.

Section: section_2 — The Geometric Setup: Solving Ax = b

Lecture lines:
[Asset: Vector_Eq] We solve the system: x v1 + y v2 = b.
[Asset: Vector_Combo] Visualize v1 and v2 as grid builders.
[Asset: Target_Vector] Aiming to reach the target vector b.

Planned animations:
Display matrix A and vector x in #FFFFFF.
Animate vector b appearing next to Ax = x.
Visualize Ax = b as linear combination of columns.
Show columns of A as vectors v1 and v2.
Display parallelogram formed by v1 and v2.

Section: section_3 — The Substitution Intuition

Lecture lines:
[Asset: Ratio_Concept] Cramer's Rule uses a ratio of areas.
[Asset: Replace_Col] Replace one column with target vector b.
[Asset: Scaling_Area] The new area is scaled by x.
[Asset: Final_Ratio] x equals the ratio of these areas.
[Asset: Cramer_Full] This logic defines Cramer's Rule geometrically.

Planned animations:
Display equation x = (x1, x2).
Show variable replacement as a transformation.
Illustrate scaling of x1 by factor s1.
Illustrate scaling of x2 by factor s2.
Show visual transformation of original parallelogram.

Section: section_4 — Visual Proof: Areas in Ratio

Lecture lines:
[Asset: Scaling_Visual] Scaling a basis vector scales the area.
[Asset: Slide_B] Slide vector b along the span.
[Asset: Area_Linearity] Area changes linearly with x.
[Asset: Isolated_X] The variable x becomes geometrically isolated.
[Asset: Proof_Complete] This completes our geometric proof.

Planned animations:
Show original area as unit square.
Draw transformed parallelogram after mapping.
Highlight the difference in area.
Overlay grid for direct comparison in D3, D4.
Draw arrows pointing to ratio of areas.

Section: section_5 — Summary and Geometric Constraint

Lecture lines:
[Asset: Zero_Det] If determinant is zero, area collapses.
[Asset: Collinear_Vectors] The vectors v1 and v2 are collinear.
[Asset: Unique_Fail] No unique solution exists in this case.

Planned animations:
Summarize key geometric relations on screen.
Show final constrained formula in #00FF00.
Fade out all elements leaving only the formula.

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        self.setup_layout("Prerequisite Recap: The Area of a Parallelogram", [

        para = Polygon(ORIGIN, v1, v1 + v2, v2, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.3)

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        self.setup_layout("Summary and Geometric Constraint", [
            "If determinant is zero, area collapses.",

            "No unique solution exists in this case."
        ])

        v1 = Vector([1, 1], color=BLUE)

        para = Polygon(ORIGIN, v1.get_end(), v1.get_end() + v2.get_end(), v2.get_end(), color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.3)
        
        group = VGroup(v1, v2, para)
        self.place_in_area(group, 'B2', 'E5', scale_factor=0.6)
        
        self.play(Create(group))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFD700")
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight collinearity
        self.play(v2.animate.set_color(ORANGE))
        self.lecture[1].set_color(ORANGE)

        self.place_at_grid(cross, 'D3', scale_factor=1.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(cross))
        self.lecture[2].set_color(RED)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(group), FadeOut(cross))
